GCSIngestion.description_en: Represents a data ingestion job that imports data from Google Cloud Storage (GCS)

createTime.description_en: Output only. The creation time of the job, as a Unix timestamp
createTime.title: 创建时间

description.description_en: A user-friendly description for the job
description.title: job description

displayName.description_en: The display name for the job
displayName.title: job displayName

lastModifiedTime.description_en: Output only. The last modified time of the job, as a Unix timestamp

GCSIngestion.title: A short description of struct

logstore.description_en: The name of the destination logstore
logstore.title: logstore

GCSIngestionConfigurationSource.description_en: Specifies the configuration for ingesting data from a Google Cloud Storage (GCS) data source

accessKeyId.description_en: The access key ID for authenticating with the GCS service. This parameter is required

accessKeySecret.description_en: The secret access key corresponding to the `accessKeyId`. This value is sensitive and must be managed securely

additionalProperties.description_en: Specifies additional advanced parameters as key-value pairs

advancedParameters.description_en: A nested object for specifying advanced configuration options as key-value pairs

bucket.description_en: The name of the GCS bucket that contains the source data files
bucket.title: gcs bucket

compressionCodec.description_en: The compression format of the source files. Supported values are `none`, `gzip`, and `zstd`. If not specified, the system infers the format from the file extension
compressionCodec.title: 压缩类型：none,snappy,gzip

encoding.description_en: The character encoding of the source files. The default value is `UTF-8`
encoding.title: 编码类型

endTime.description_en: The end of the time range for data ingestion, specified as a Unix timestamp (in seconds). Only objects modified before this time are ingested
endTime.description_zh: 某个时间点前修改过的文件
endTime.title: 某个时间点前修改过的文件

endpoint.description_en: The service endpoint for GCS. You can use a custom endpoint for private or accelerated connections
endpoint.title: gcs endpoint

additionalProperties.description_en: Specifies format-specific properties as key-value pairs. For example, you can set a `delimiter` for CSV files

format.description_en: A nested object that defines the format of the source data, such as CSV, JSON, or Parquet
format.title: 格式

interval.description_en: The interval for checking for new data. Specify the value in a duration format, such as `15m` for 15 minutes. Set to `never` to perform a one-time ingestion
interval.title: 检查新文件周期

pattern.description_en: A regular expression that specifies which files to ingest. The pattern is matched against the full object key within the specified prefix
pattern.title: 文件路径正则过滤

prefix.description_en: The object key prefix used to discover files. This limits the scope of ingestion to a specific "folder" within the bucket
prefix.title: 文件路径前缀过滤

processorId.description_en: The unique ID of the processor or pipeline that handles the ingested data
processorId.title: 写入处理器id

restoreObjectEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to automatically restore objects from archival storage classes before ingestion. Set to `true` to enable this feature. The default is `false`
restoreObjectEnabled.title: 导入归档文件

startTime.description_en: The start of the time range for data ingestion, specified as a Unix timestamp (in seconds). Only objects modified at or after this time are ingested
startTime.description_zh: 某个时间点后修改过的文件
startTime.title: 某个时间点后修改过的文件

tagPackId.description_en: The ID of a predefined tag pack to apply to the ingested data. Tag packs contain rules for data enrichment and categorization
tagPackId.title: 启动上下文检索

timeField.description_en: The name of the field in your data that contains the timestamp. This timestamp is used as the event time for the ingested records
timeField.title: 提取时间字段

timeFormat.description_en: The format of the timestamp in the `timeField`, specified using the Java `SimpleDateFormat` pattern. For example: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`
timeFormat.title: 时间字段格式

timePattern.description_en: A regular expression used to extract a timestamp from unstructured data, such as a log entry or filename, if a structured `timeField` is not available
timePattern.title: 提取时间正则

timeZone.description_en: The time zone for parsing timestamps that lack explicit time zone information. Specify a valid time zone identifier, such as `UTC` or `America/Los_Angeles`
timeZone.title: 时间字段分区
